verdicts.rationale: OBSERVED: PUT /collections/{name} with vectors={} returns 200, but PUT /collections/{name}/points with vector data returns 400 'Not existing vector name error'. DOCUMENTED INTENT: structured_contract.json line 3217 explicitly states 'collections without vector config support payload-only operations (vector insert returns an error at use time)'. DEVELOPER STANCE: developer_cognition.json lines 13-15 confirm 'Payload-only collections: creating a collection without vector configuration is a supported use case, errors surface on first vector use'. SOURCE CODE: operation_error.rs defines VectorNameNotExists as legitimate error; types.rs implements explicit validation via check_vector_names(); test_optional_vectors.py:667 expects this exact error as CORRECT behavior. REVERSE FALSIFICATION: Verified that payload-only operations (POST /points/payload, scroll) work correctly on collections with empty vectors config, confirming this is intentional payload-only collection support. CONCLUSION: This is a documented feature, not a defect. The behavior matches the API contract and developer intent.
